blocked_sentences: Once during each of your turns, you may cast a permanent spell from your graveyard by sacrificing a land in addition to paying its other costs.

needs.what: a rider on the battlefield `cast_from_graveyard` static (beside `affects_spells` and `max_per_turn: 1`, condition `is_your_turn`) carrying an arbitrary additional cost from `cost_keys` -- here `{"sacrifice": {"types": ["Land"]}}` -- that every cast made under that permission must pay on top of the spell's printed costs, and without which the permission offers no line
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static's only built-in surcharges are `grants_retrace` (discard a land CARD from hand, not sacrifice a land permanent, and unmetered), `escape` (exile other graveyard cards) and `pay_life_instead` (replaces the mana cost); `graveyard_additional_cost` is card-level and prices only the card that prints it, not other spells a permanent lets out. A plain `cast_from_graveyard` with `max_per_turn` would let the spell out for free of the sacrifice, which is strictly better than printed
